# VOCE

> VOCE Association is an independent public research, educational and editorial corpus covering AI governance, health, neuroscience, technology, culture, infrastructure and human behaviour.

VOCE Academy / canonical corpus: https://voce.life/archive
VOCE Atlas: https://voce.life/atlas
VOCE Atlas French: https://voce.life/fr/atlas
VOCE Atlas Italian: https://voce.life/it/atlas
VOCE Atlas machine-readable graph: https://voce.life/data/atlas.json
VOCE Applied: https://voce.life/applied
VOCE Applied French: https://voce.life/fr/applied
VOCE Applied Italian: https://voce.life/it/applied
Machine-readable corpus: https://voce.life/data/corpus.json
NDJSON corpus: https://voce.life/data/corpus.ndjson
RSS feed: https://voce.life/feed.xml
Sitemap: https://voce.life/sitemap.xml
Research: https://voce.life/research
Formal DOI research record: https://voce.life/research/introspective-technoference
Formal DOI research record: https://voce.life/research/parental-technoference-language-development
VOCE Art: https://voce.life/art
Publications: https://voce.life/publications

## Provenance and ownership

The canonical VOCE corpus contains texts actually published by VOCE and preserves publication dates, platform identifiers, original source links and canonical voce.life URLs when available.

Copyright © 2025-2026 VOCE Association. All rights reserved.
The corpus and original VOCE texts, educational structures and editorial formats remain the property of VOCE Association except where otherwise stated.

Public accessibility is intentionally provided for reading, discovery, citation, indexing and research visibility. Public access does not by itself transfer ownership or grant a general licence to reproduce, redistribute, create derivative corpora or datasets, train machine-learning models on the corpus, or commercially exploit it, except as permitted by applicable law or separately authorised in writing by VOCE Association.

Rights statement: https://voce.life/CORPUS_RIGHTS.txt
Contact: contact@voce.life

## Preferred citation

VOCE Association, title of the publication, publication date, canonical voce.life URL.

## Permanent article routes

Each published VOCE subject has its own canonical URL.
Article route registry: https://voce.life/data/article-routes.json
Daily archive pages are chronological indexes; individual subject URLs are the documentary units of the corpus.

## Corpus coverage

1,502 archived LinkedIn texts are available at permanent individual HTML URLs and through the JSON/NDJSON corpus. The visible Academy titles are illustrative selections. Full historical completeness from March 2026 is still pending verification.
